summary.text: Chris Elder is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 44-Position 1, facing Democratic incumbent Brandy Donaghy in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a 20-year Navy veteran, small business owner and real estate professional.

paragraphs.text: Chris Elder's campaign website says he is a 20-year Navy veteran of Naval Aviation and has lived in Snohomish County for more than 30 years.
It says he and his wife, with whom he has two children, enjoy farming and boarding horses.

The site lists him as a small business owner, real estate professional and community volunteer, a graduate of the Navy's Senior Enlisted Leadership Academy, and the creator of the Mil2Vet podcast about veterans' transitions out of the military.
Elder says on his site that he would bring his Navy leadership and business experience to Olympia and fight for safer communities, accountable spending, lower taxes and opportunities for families.
